Ellen — thanks for the clear ask. We're preparing a single evidence bundle and a short owner matrix. High level answers below; attaching the detailed matrix and evidence pack in my next message.

Quick summary (high level):
- Hosted (Redwood API): Redwood security owns evidence collection and redaction; artifacts available in our compliance drive and delivered via secure link. Typical SLA: 3–5 business days for standard SIG items, quicker for narrow requests.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): Responsibility is shared — Redwood provides the runtime artifacts (patch records, kernel configs, monitoring logs) and the customer provides tenancy-level network configs and any customer-managed keys. Evidence handoff usually 3–7 business days depending on scope.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): Customers typically own most environment-level evidence (on-prem configs, HSM snapshots). Redwood provides platform-level artifacts and attestation for features we operate (agents, control plane interactions). Delivery timing varies; plan on 7–14 business days for combined artifacts.

I'll send the full bundle in a follow-up with links and an attached Excel mapping.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin

Ellen — attaching the consolidated artifacts and an owner map for each SIG section you called out. Summary below; see attachments for direct links and extraction instructions.

1) Ownership summary (per deployment mode)- Hosted (Redwood API): Redwood security is primary owner for evidence requests. We provide: SOC 2 scope statement, tenant activity logs (redacted), service configuration snapshots, and network egress diagrams. Delivery SLA: 3 business days for standard SIG items.

- Where to find artifacts: Drive folder -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBxExampleEvidenceFolder/hosted
- Contact for delivery: compliance@redwood.com

- Attachments included: hosted-logs-sample.txt (log excerpt), hosted-soc2-scope.pdf

- Dedicated (Reserved capacity): Shared ownership. Redwood provides runtime artifacts and attestations; customer provides tenancy/network specifics and any customer-managed key evidence. Delivery SLA: 3–7 business days based on customer input.

- Where to find artifacts (Redwood portions): Drive folder -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBxExampleEvidenceFolder/dedicated
- Items included: dedicated-patch-history.csv, dedicated-isolation-notes.pdf

- Private (VPC / On-prem): Customer owns most environment artifacts. Redwood provides control-plane attestations and operational logs we can export when relevant. Typical combined timeline: 7–14 business days.

- Where to find Redwood-provided artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBxExampleEvidenceFolder/private
- Note: Private evidence often requires coordination with the customer's infra/security team; see 'delivery notes' in attachment.

2) Redaction and PII constraints
- Redwood will proactively redact PII from standard log exports. For any retained sensitive items, we'll send redacted copies and provide a separate attestation describing redaction steps.

3) Next steps for BigBank
- Confirm which SIG sections you want Redwood to own end-to-end vs items you will supply (we filled the owner table in the attached Excel).
